## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7b89373f3a98df4913f09403d5ebc179ba720b10`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs + scripts/pm/round-open.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs
Rule-change-verified: none

PR #38212 (`Part of #35237`, slice 9: carrier items 16–19 and L1 N4 of PR #38146). Read: card #35237 body and all 37 comments, the PR body, its 6-file list, the net diff of the head against merge base `e3bdc748841f8ec72aedc3d795227273f25c6baa` (+14/-12), and the check-runs on the head. The whole diff is in scope (4 `hits` + 2 implementing files); there is no remainder for a separate ACCEPT.

Check-runs on the head: 26 success, 23 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. Among the successes: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`.

Rule-change, verified hunk by hunk against the diff (the PR body declares `Rule-change: none`):
- `area-lease.md` 留道: drops 「与 `--tier` 提示」 from the precedence clause. At the head `tierLines` in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (:13506, :13517) prints that a contract-surface hit no longer moves the card, so there is no lane-move hint left for 留道 to outrank. The rule (修法已清的卡留本席开发、本席 L1/L2; the closed hand-over set) is byte-identical.
- `contract-review.md` trigger (b): 「已等满一轮(约 60 分钟)」 becomes 「已等满一轮」. The length is unchanged: `seat-lifecycle.md:5` spells 「一轮 60 分钟」 and `check-owed-reviews.mjs` still reads (b) at 60 minutes. Who reviews, when, and what goes to the maintainer are unchanged.
- `execution-duties.md` 强制条款②: drops the aside that `--tier` still prints the spec-lane sentence. The rule sentence 「默认判断档施工;不再移卡,开发与审核留接卡席」 is kept whole.
No hunk alters what an agent may do without the maintainer, what gets done or in what order, or what must go to him. These are wording and slimming.

### ① Derived judgments

- Published accept sets and public surface: none touched. Every path is `.claude/**` or `scripts/pm/**`; no package, schema or `exports` map is in the diff. `Clause-②: no` is right.
- `scripts/pm/round-open.mjs` module surface: `ROUND_PHRASE` and `CONTRACT_REVIEW_PATH` are removed, `ROUND_RULE` and `roundMinutesOfRule` are added. Right: at the head no file in the tree imports or names the two removed exports (the only remaining names are in `round-open.mjs` itself), and the script is unpublished tooling.
- The round-length pin's accept set changes, and the change is right. Before: `contract-review.md` had to contain a fixed phrase, and the second leg compared two constants of the same file to each other, so it could not go red on a changed rule. After: `seat-lifecycle.md` must spell 「一轮 N 分钟」 exactly once and N must equal `ROUND_MINUTES`. A changed figure, a second spelling, or a respelled line (no match, reads `[]`) each fail the case. That is stricter and fails closed.
- `record-recognisers.mjs`: one self-test title string. No recogniser, template or constant changes; the accept set of every reader is unchanged.
- `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`: one docblock sentence. No glob, pin or table row changes.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no — nothing published changes, so no changeset is owed. The PR carries `skip-changeset`, and `Check Changeset` succeeded on the head. Level: none. This matches what the diff publishes (nothing).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 7235804265: `open_questions` is empty; `security_findings` none. Nothing to answer or escalate.
- Out-of-scope finding 1 (`scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs:138` keeps `TRIAGE_ROUND_MINUTES = 60` with a comment quoting the phrase this PR removes): confirmed at the head. It is outside the diff and outside the claim's fence, and it is carried as item 20 on #35237 (comment 7235828687). Answered: the carrier is the right place. It is not a regression of this PR, because that constant was unpinned before it too.
- Out-of-scope finding 2 (nothing pins `contract-review.md` against a figure coming back): accepted as stated. The byte ratchet (file at 6403, ceiling 6419) is the only brake; a new gate for it is not owed by this slice.
- The claim's fences held: `SKILL.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `os-dev.md` and item 7 option B are not in the diff. No ceiling row moved (area-lease 6565 of 6586, execution-duties 22226 of 22307).
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff has no data access, no id materialisation and no join.

### ④ Design judgment

`contract-review.md` (hits). Accepted against carrier item 16 and the L2 record's ③ in 7214100600 (the number lives on the `seat-lifecycle.md` rule line). Trigger (b) holds against the code it is read by: `check-owed-reviews.mjs:358` fires (b) once the wait reaches `TRIAGE_ROUND_MINUTES`, 60, the same number `seat-lifecycle.md:5` now carries alone. The order item 16 asked for (pin moved before the figure is dropped, one PR) is what the diff does. The verbatim hand-off template on line 23 is untouched, so the record-recognisers case that reads it still holds.

`execution-duties.md` (hits). Accepted against carrier item 17. The dropped clause described script output that no longer exists: `git grep` at the head finds no spec-lane or "moves there" sentence in `dispatch-gates.mjs` or `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`. The remaining line agrees with what `--tier` prints (:13506) and with the neighbouring line 107 (收窄卡不移车道).

`area-lease.md` (hits). Accepted against carrier item 19. Tried to break it: `--tier` still prints a clause-② SUSPECT hint, so is a hint that 留道 must outrank being un-ranked? No. That hint at the head (:13517) says build and review are both by the claiming seat, which is 留道's own answer, so no precedence is needed. The kept reference to `domains/spec.md` still resolves (the file exists at the head and opens with 域席已退役).

`record-recognisers.mjs` (hits). Accepted against L1 N4 of PR #38146. The new title says what the case asserts: the case checks only that `contract-review.md` carries `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE` verbatim in a code span and that the template starts with the key. The case it points at exists two lines below (its title starts "every target shape the TEMPLATE offers, filled in, READS") and does read each shape back through the reader. No battery floor counts titles.

`round-open.mjs` (implementing). Sentence by sentence against `seat-lifecycle.md:5`, 「未收班活动任一未满一轮 ⇒ 自退(一轮 60 分钟);现读 `round-open.mjs`」:
- The docblock (:43) and the `ROUND_MINUTES` comment (:96) name that line as the source, and the quoted spelling matches the file.
- `roundMinutesOfRule` uses `matchAll`, which works on a copy of the regex, so the exported `/g` constant keeps no state between calls here.
- Line 88 of `seat-lifecycle.md` (「一轮 ≥ 半数派发失败」) does not match the pattern, so "spelled once" holds on the live text: the reading is `[60]`.
- The second case is not a tautology: with the rule text at another figure, the `replace` finds nothing and the first case alone goes red, which is what the PR body's ablation shows (1 of 38). Its second half proves a line without the spelling reads none.
- The battery floor 2 to 3 equals the three cases the battery registers.

`dispatch-gates.data.mjs` (implementing). The new docblock sentence agrees with `tierLines` word for word in substance ("no longer moves the card", "build and review stay with the claiming seat") and with the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` docblock in `dispatch-gates.mjs:13270-13273`. "As `--tier` says" is true at the head.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

N1 (nit) — The PR body and the L1 note say the round figure now lives on one rule line only. In the tree, `references/landing-operations.md:93` still spells 「一轮分诊(~60 分钟)」, in a form `ROUND_RULE` does not read. It is a different rule (约定③) and outside this slice, so the diff is right as it stands. Add it to carrier item 20, so that item covers both remaining copies.
N2 (nit) — `contract-review.md` (b) now says 一轮 with no figure and no pointer to where the length is written. The byte budget explains it, and `check-owed-reviews.mjs` prints the waited minutes on every row. If item 20 imports `ROUND_MINUTES`, the reader is covered. Left as an accepted deviation.
N3 (nit) — `ROUND_RULE` is exported with the `g` flag. An importer calling `.test()` on it would carry `lastIndex` between calls. Nothing imports it today. Left for the file's next edit.

Independence: the diff was produced by `session_016WV4cxRDKprCtjpEdtiPFW` on the branch below. This record is rendered by a different session, from the card, the PR and the check-runs alone. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

A changed figure on that line goes red, and so does a second spelling. This is stricter than the old phrase pin, and it fails closed.

- **N4 of #38146.** The `record-recognisers.mjs` self-test title now says what it asserts.

**Nits, optional.** None of these needs a new head.
- N1: `references/landing-operations.md` line 93 still spells a round figure. Fold it into the next carrier item.
- N2: trigger (b) in `contract-review.md` now carries no pointer to where the length lives.
- N3: the exported `ROUND_RULE` has the `g` flag, so an importer calling `.test()` would carry state. Nothing imports it today.
